'''Alianna Slen''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] citizen of the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]]. Daughter of [[Tayvor Slen]], the [[Overwatch]] administrator, she joined up with the [[Flamechasers]], who idolized the anarchist known as [[Kaliyo Djannis|Firebrand]]. As a mark of pride, Alianna acquired large prominent scarring on her face. In [[3630 BBY]] BBY Firebrand used her proximity to Overwatch and persuaded Alianna to obtain Overwatch access data from her father and assist her in planting explosives throughout the city. Alianna met up with Firebrand one last time to hand over the data and inform her that the rest of the Flamechasers had left the following and were getting their scars fixed.<ref name="SWTOR" />

Firebrand and [[Alliance Commander|the Commander]] eventually stormed the Overwatch, killed Tayvor and destroyed the droid controls, disabling thousands of droids that enabled Zakuulan life. Aware that Firebrand's full plan involved detonating the bombs planted throughout the city as well, Alianna was grateful that the bigger disaster was averted.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Alianna Slen appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' '''Chapter X: Anarchy in Paradise'''. If the player picks the Dark Side options and detonates the bombs, Alianna is accused of being Firebrand by the Eternal Empire and is executed.

Her surname is misspelled as ''Slenn'' in a Zakuul News Bulletin announcement.
